tasks.short: Examine the site, select charges professionally and record the assessment.

steps.what: Retrieve applicable safety laws and the current site assessment documents
Examine blast areas and assess site conditions and safety constraints
Determine appropriate explosive charges and whether the proposed work meets safety requirements
outputs: professional charge selection and compliance assessment

steps.what: Write site findings and the selected assessment into the working plan
inputs: professional charge selection and compliance assessment

tasks.design: Configure a controlled reference view and assessment template in {DOCS}. The blaster examines the site and makes every technical and compliance decision; the separate plan entry reuses headings without generating charge recommendations.
tasks.previous_blocker: Finding current references and repeating assessment headings add handling.
tasks.enabler_now: Native document links and templates can reduce navigation and repeated layout.
tasks.still_hard: Site conditions, charge selection and interpretation of applicable obligations.
tasks.human_edge: Professional responsibility for physical hazards and the suitability of the assessment.
tasks.altitude: Spend less time arranging references and more on the site assessment.

evidence.claim: Controlled document views and templates can reduce reference and layout handling; benefit here is an unmeasured scenario.

assumptions: The baseline includes writing the working assessment, separately from the site visit and technical selection.
The blaster supplies site identity and jurisdiction in s1 and all findings in s2-s3; their capture and interpretation remain counted. Missing or outdated references require manual retrieval.
Native templates are checked before custom software. No automated operational recommendation or send is proposed.
An ordinary save is included in s4 and receives no separate approval or saving.
unknowns: Applicable jurisdiction and controlled document system
Actual proportion of time spent entering the plan
research_questions: Do five observed assessments show repeated reference navigation and template entry without reducing examination time?

already_counted.description: Manual checking of current references and full technical assessment

incremental.description: Maintain the reference index and template

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 central B100 R94 gives 6 gross minus 1 upkeep =5 net. Low: site-specific references and incompatible assessment layout leave R99 and 1 upkeep, net0. High: a reusable reference index but mostly bespoke narrative leaves R96 and 1 upkeep, net3. Examination and charge decisions remain fully retained in both cases.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Place safety cones, signal workers and personally verify that the site is clear.

steps.what: Inspect blast areas and identify the physical boundary requiring cones
Place safety cones at the required site boundary
Check the current instruction and signal workers to clear the blast site
Observe workers leaving and verify site clearance under the established safety procedure
outputs: personally verified clearance or unresolved concern

tasks.design: Retain physical placement, worker communication and personal clearance verification. A native {DOCS} procedure view may support training, but no document template or screen setting removes the physical work represented here.
tasks.previous_blocker: The task requires presence and confirmation of actual worker movement.
tasks.enabler_now: No supported software change removes these physical actions.
tasks.still_hard: Changing occupancy and whether every worker has understood the instruction.
tasks.human_edge: Direct observation and immediate clarification at the site.
tasks.altitude: Protect the time needed for visible boundaries and verified clearance.

evidence.claim: A template cannot place physical cones or establish that workers have actually left; zero saving is an E1 judgement.

assumptions: This task describes physical placement, an internal spoken signal and observed clearance. It does not specify a separate written clearance register; none is hidden in a meeting step.
The blaster observes boundary and occupancy in s1 and s4; no structured sold-clear flag is assumed or machine action triggered.
A native procedure view is considered but receives no saving because reference lookup is not a material baseline activity here.
No new system is introduced, so there is no incremental upkeep.
unknowns: Whether local practice adds a separately timed clearance log
research_questions: Does observation reveal any actual record entry or reference lookup that should be separately timed?

already_counted.description: Physical placement, communication and clearance checks

incremental.description: No system change or new upkeep

approvals.approved_version: The exact clearance instruction, site boundary and intended workers checked immediately before signaling; changed conditions require a fresh check.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100, no upkeep and no claimed gain. Physical boundary placement, personal signaling and observed clearance remain fully retained; no repeated record write is priced inside them.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Compile and maintain controlled gun and explosives records with human reconciliation.

steps.what: Retrieve source documents and the applicable records requirements
outputs: identified source pack and required fields

steps.what: Reconcile source transactions and resolve missing identifiers or conflicting quantities
inputs: identified source pack and required fields
outputs: reconciled transaction details or unresolved exceptions

steps.what: Compile gun and explosives records from the reconciled source details
inputs: reconciled transaction details or unresolved exceptions
identified source pack and required fields

steps.what: Check record completeness and keep the required supporting records accessible
inputs: identified source pack and required fields
outputs: checked register with linked supporting records

tasks.design: Configure required fields, reusable record layouts and linked source views in {OPS_SYSTEM} and {DOCS}. The custodian reconciles sources, enters the record and checks completeness; no legal interpretation, regulatory submission or unattended inventory adjustment is automated.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated navigation and manual record layout consume time alongside necessary reconciliation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native controlled forms and linked source records can reduce repeated entry without a language model.
tasks.still_hard: Conflicting source quantities, missing identifiers and jurisdiction-specific obligations.
tasks.human_edge: Recognising an unresolved discrepancy and preserving an accurate audit trail.
tasks.altitude: Move effort from repeated layout to source reconciliation.

evidence.claim: Native required-field forms and linked source views can support controlled records; the proposed labour benefit is E1 and not an explosives compliance case.

assumptions: The existing record system can provide configurable forms; it is not assumed to be a certified explosives product.

The custodian captures record identity, date, item identifier, transaction reference and quantities from source documents in s2-s3. Actual mandatory fields require local validation; missing values remain manual exceptions.
No undocumented structured feed or automatic balance calculation is assumed. Native configuration is tried before a custom build.
The author's ordinary save remains included at full effort in the retained portion of s3; it has no approval gate or independent saving.
unknowns: Actual jurisdiction, mandatory record fields and access requirements
Whether existing forms already remove repeated entry
research_questions: Can native form defaults reduce observed entry effort while every source discrepancy remains manually resolved?

incremental.description: Maintain field definitions and source links

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 central B100 R84 gives16 gross minus2 upkeep =14 net. Low: diverse document identifiers and no reusable item defaults leave lookup19, reconciliation25, entry38 and checking15, R97; net1. High: stable transaction layouts but manual identifier checks leave lookup17, reconciliation25, entry32 and checking15, R89; net9. No saving is assigned to same-system saves or legal judgement.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Observe available indications and personally verify detonation status.

steps.what: Observe control panels or listen for the sounds associated with the blast
inputs: live control panel indications or audible observations

steps.what: Assess whether the observed indications support verification of detonation

tasks.design: Retain observation and professional interpretation of {OTHER}, the existing blast control panel, or audible indications. A dashboard would reproduce indications without establishing a reliable new verification capability.
tasks.previous_blocker: The decisive input is a live physical event rather than a prepared document.
tasks.enabler_now: No supported software change establishes equivalent verification for this task.
tasks.still_hard: Ambiguous indications and uncertainty about actual site conditions.
tasks.human_edge: Accountable interpretation of the observations and recognition of uncertainty.
tasks.altitude: Preserve attention for verification and unresolved indications.

reach.task: Understand the limits of observed status
reach.learn: Distinguish an indication from confirmed status

evidence.claim: An existing panel display does not establish that a new software layer can replace accountable physical verification; zero gain is an E1 judgement.

assumptions: The task specifies observation and verification, not a written report or send. No record entry is concealed inside these steps; separately required log work must be measured if present.
Existing panel hardware produces its live indications; the blaster observes them in s1. No structured confirmed-detonation flag or machine action is assumed.
Native panel views and templates cannot remove the physical verification effort counted here. No custom dashboard is proposed.
No change is introduced and incremental upkeep is zero.
unknowns: Whether site practice includes an actual verification log within this task
research_questions: Does direct observation identify any separate recurring lookup or record write, and how long does it take?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 with zero upkeep. Live observations and professional verification remain fully retained; no existing hardware runtime or hypothetical reporting work is credited as labour saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Use controlled records to support accountable site work without automating hazardous technical decisions.
reach: Help supervisors locate current assessment records
Help compliance colleagues trace source documents
skills_to_grow: Clear separation of observed indications and verified status
role.ambitious_version: A practitioner with less repeated record handling and protected attention for physical safety decisions.
